○ agentic-devlopment-ma4 [EPIC] · Single-agent reliability: commit-safe candidate proof and no-delegation fallbacks   [● P1 · OPEN]
Owner: PhD Jonathan MERCIER · Type: epic
Created: 2026-11-19 · Updated: 2026-11-19

DESCRIPTION

  Goal: the Skills complete a cycle reliably on a single-agent host and keep  
  exact-candidate proof valid across authorized commits.                      
  Goals: G1 a commit made during Implement does not silently invalidate       
  Test/Judge candidate evidence; one documented, testable rule decides how    
  evidence binds across a commit. G2 Research and Plan readiness gates have a 
  disclosed, limited-independence path when no subagent/worker is available,  
  instead of stalling on a permission request.                                
  Non-goals: waiving the independence required for acceptance (Judge/US       
  acceptance still needs the review policy); changing candidate_identity.py   
  hashing unless research shows it is required; automatic commits.            
  Requirements:                                                               
  FR-1 (31k) Given an authorized commit after focused checks, when Test       
  compares the candidate, then the Skills state either commit-after-Test/Judge
  or an exact rebind procedure (what is compared, what is excluded) so the    
  outcome is deterministic, with a red-capable test.                          
  FR-2 (qu2) Given no worker/subagent capability, when Research needs deeper  
  investigation or Plan needs its global delegated challenge, then the        
  coordinator proceeds directly and discloses reduced independence as a limit;
  Judge acceptance independence rules are unchanged.                          
  Decision: epic selected by user 2026-11-19 ('next epic', default            
  recommendation 31k + qu2).

"""Static source evidence plus a CLI fixture for FR-1 (agentic-devlopment-31k).

FR-1: given an authorized commit after focused checks, when Test compares the
candidate, the Skills state an exact rebind procedure (what is compared, what is
excluded) so the outcome is deterministic. The source checks read instruction
text only; the fixture runs the bundled capture CLI and Git in a temporary
repository. Neither executes an agent workflow or proves agent compliance.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
NAMES = ('cycle', 'research', 'plan', 'implement', 'test', 'judge', 'iterate')
CLI = ROOT / 'skills/implement/scripts/candidate_identity.py'
PREVIOUS_VERSION = (1, 3, 0)


def flat(path):
    return ' '.join(path.read_text().split())


def rebind_projection(manifest):
    """Independent oracle for the documented rule: drop candidate_id and git."""
    return {k: v for k, v in manifest.items() if k not in ('candidate_id', 'git')}


class CommitRebindSource(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.paths = [ROOT / 'skills' / n / 'references/candidate-identity.md' for n in NAMES]
        self.text = flat(self.paths[0])

    def test_seven_candidate_identity_copies_are_byte_identical(self):
        self.assertEqual(len({hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in self.paths}), 1)

    def test_contract_version_bumped_minor_with_title(self):
        raw = self.paths[0].read_text()
        major, minor, patch = PREVIOUS_VERSION
        version = f'{major}.{minor + 1}.0'
        self.assertIn('Contract version: ' + version, raw)
        self.assertIn('# Candidate identity v' + version, raw)

    def test_fr1_rebind_states_compared_and_excluded_fields(self):
        for rule in ('## C. Rebind evidence across a commit',
                     'capture again after the commit with the same root and scope',
                     'excluding only candidate_id and git (HEAD and index)',
                     'Otherwise rerun the affected checks',
                     'git diff --quiet HEAD --',
                     'consumes Git state'):
            self.assertIn(rule, self.text)

    def test_fr1_undefined_rebind_wording_removed(self):
        implement = flat(ROOT / 'skills/implement/SKILL.md')
        self.assertNotIn('rebind documented equality', implement)
        self.assertNotIn('documented content/environment equality', self.text)

    def test_fr1_implement_freezes_post_commit_candidate(self):
        implement = flat(ROOT / 'skills/implement/SKILL.md')
        step5 = implement.split('5. [ ]', 1)[1].split('6. [ ]', 1)[0]
        for rule in ('After a performed commit, capture the handoff candidate again',
                     'freeze its new candidate_id',
                     'commit rebind in candidate identity'):
            self.assertIn(rule, step5)


class CommitRebindFixture(unittest.TestCase):
    """Commit of identical content: candidate_id changes, rebind projection holds."""

    def setUp(self):
        tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(tmp.name)
        self.root = self.base / 'root'
        (self.root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root / 'src/a.txt').write_text('base\n')
        self.scope = self.base / 'scope.json'
        self.scope.write_text(json.dumps({'include': ['src'], 'exclude': [],
            'environment': {'python': 'fixture'}, 'criteria': 'FR-1-fixture'}))
        self.git('init', '-q')
        self.git('config', 'user.name', 'Fixture')
        self.git('config', 'user.email', 'fixture@example.invalid')
        self.git('add', '.')
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'baseline')

    def git(self, *args, check=True):
        return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(self.root), *args], capture_output=True,
                              text=True, check=check)

    def capture(self, name):
        out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(CLI), 'capture', '--root',
                              str(self.root), '--scope', str(self.scope)],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        (self.base / name).write_text(out)
        return json.loads(out)

    def compare(self):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(CLI), 'compare',
                               str(self.base / 'before.json'), str(self.base / 'after.json')],
                              capture_output=True, text=True).returncode

    def test_identical_content_commit_rebinds_but_compare_differs(self):
        (self.root / 'src/a.txt').write_text('changed\n')
        before = self.capture('before.json')       # unstaged change, as after checks
        self.git('add', 'src/a.txt')
        staged_tree = self.git('write-tree').stdout.strip()
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'change')
        after = self.capture('after.json')
        self.assertEqual(self.compare(), 1)        # HEAD/index moved: DIFFERENT
        self.assertEqual(rebind_projection(before), rebind_projection(after))
        self.assertEqual(self.git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}').stdout.strip(), staged_tree)
        self.assertEqual(self.git('diff', '--quiet', 'HEAD', '--', 'src', check=False).returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.documented_rebind(), 0)

    def documented_rebind(self):
        """Run the documented section C command verbatim against the fixture manifests."""
        text = (ROOT / 'skills/implement/references/candidate-identity.md').read_text()
        section = text.split('## C. Rebind evidence across a commit', 1)[1]
        command = section.split('~~~sh\n', 1)[1].split('~~~', 1)[0]
        return subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', command], capture_output=True, text=True,
                              env={**os.environ, 'EVIDENCE_DIR': str(self.base)}).returncode

    def test_content_change_after_commit_breaks_rebind(self):
        before = self.capture('before.json')
        (self.root / 'src/a.txt').write_text('edited later\n')
        after = self.capture('after.json')
        self.assertNotEqual(rebind_projection(before), rebind_projection(after))
        self.assertEqual(self.documented_rebind(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.git('diff', '--quiet', 'HEAD', '--', 'src', check=False).returncode, 1)

without workers or a review, and establish no behavioral effectiveness.

Research and Plan proceed directly and disclose reduced independence as a limit;

rules are unchanged.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import re
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LABEL = 'direct, reduced independence'


def read(path):
    return (ROOT / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def flat(text):
    return ' '.join(text.split())


class NoDelegationFallback(unittest.TestCase):
    sources = {
        'research skill': 'skills/research/SKILL.md',
        'research contract': 'skills/research/references/delegated-investigation.md',
        'plan skill': 'skills/plan/SKILL.md',
        'plan readiness': 'skills/plan/references/plan-readiness-review.md',
    }

    def test_fallback_proceeds_directly_with_disclosed_limit(self):
        for name, path in self.sources.items():
            with self.subTest(source=name):
                text = flat(read(path))
                self.assertIn(LABEL, text)
                # Absence of capability, not mere non-use, triggers the fallback.
                self.assertRegex(text, r'no worker capability[^.]*not merely unused'
                                 r'|not merely unused[^.]*no worker capability')
                self.assertRegex(text, r'proceed')

    def test_user_is_asked_only_for_missing_permission(self):
        for name, path in self.sources.items():
            with self.subTest(source=name):
                text = flat(read(path))
                self.assertRegex(text, re.compile(r'ask the user only for a missing permission', re.I))

    def test_stalling_permission_and_waiver_wording_removed(self):
        stalls = ('explicit permission for direct investigation',
                  'explicit direct-investigation waiver',
                  'do not substitute ticket readback or self-review for this gate')
        for name, path in self.sources.items():
            text = flat(read(path))
            for stall in stalls:
                with self.subTest(source=name, stall=stall):
                    self.assertNotIn(stall, text)

    def test_fallback_is_not_independence_or_acceptance(self):
        research = flat(read(self.sources['research skill']))
        self.assertRegex(research, r'(required|mandatory) isolation or independence')
        self.assertIn('never fall back silently', research.lower())
        readiness = flat(read(self.sources['plan readiness']))
        for rule in ('no silent direct fallback', 'not independent review or acceptance',
                     'global approval gate pending', 'exact prerequisite'):
            self.assertIn(rule, readiness)

    def test_acceptance_independence_policy_unchanged(self):
        policy = read('skills/research/references/review-policy.md')
        for rule in ('a builder\'s saved plan or an\nabsence of reviewer tools is not a waiver',
                     'If independence is required and unavailable, use indeterminate'):
            self.assertIn(rule.lower(), policy.lower())
        copies = {hashlib.sha256((p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                  for p in ROOT.glob('skills/*/references/review-policy.md')}
        self.assertEqual(len(copies), 1, 'review-policy copies diverged')
        judge = flat(read('skills/judge/SKILL.md'))
        self.assertIn('never claim independence', judge)
        self.assertNotIn(LABEL, judge)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
